coaching.headline: A clean 3-stack map win — towers 9–5, objectives 20–15. We took the structures and closed at 31 minutes.
coaching.team: This is the trio working: out-towered them 9-5 and converted the objective lead. Willy's Steel set the table (13 assists) and Xeebs' Serath carried the jungle with 43215 objective damage. Cuban's Feng Mao ran quiet at 9144 hero damage, but the map control covered it. Repeat this — control neutrals, convert to towers.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: This is our template as a trio — with one tighten: the 6, 12.9 and 15.2 fights were lost while the winning carry stayed in lane, and 4 of 7 won fights cashed. Shove-and-rotate those and it's a stomp.

perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Steel support, 13 assists, 9-5 towers — elite enabling from Willy Guggenheim. Five deaths is a touch high for a frontline tank.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Serath jungle, 7/6, into an unfavored Bayle matchup — controlled the jungle and the objectives anyway, which set up the 9-5 tower lead.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Feng Mao offlane into a losing Khaimera matchup (43%) — held it at 2/1/5, but 9144 hero damage was the team's lowest. Trade more once even.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
ourKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
ourKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
ourKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

ourKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
ourKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
ourKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

ourKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
ourKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
ourKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
enemyKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy
enemyKits.playWith: CC and chokes that force enemies into his zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile turret — flank his mine zones, dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

ability.name: Ancestral Fury
ability.what: Damaging Enemy Heroes or Jungle Monsters grants Khaimera Rage.

loadout.plain: Hitting minions now builds Rage, so you can walk into a fight already charged and your cooldowns tick faster from the first swing. The trade is weaker passive healing early, so you sustain less in lane before level 16.

loadout.name: Exarch
loadout.text: Healing or Shielding a target (including yourself) grants them 10% Total Attack Speed and empowers their Basic Attacks to deal 10% bonus Magical Damage On-Hit for 4s.
loadout.plain: Healing yourself, like with Invigorate or lifesteal, gives a short window of extra attack speed and magical on-hit damage. Pop Invigorate mid-fight and keep swinging.

loadout.name: Illumination
loadout.text: Gain Health Regeneration equal to your Bonus Mana Regeneration.
loadout.plain: Health regeneration equal to your bonus mana regeneration. Khaimera rarely builds mana regeneration, so this adds little for him.

loadout.name: Fervour
loadout.text: Basic Attacks against Enemy Heroes heal you and allies within 1000 units for 2 (+0.5 per level)(+5% Magical Power).
loadout.plain: Basic attacks on heroes heal you and nearby allies a little. Unleash's fast hits trigger it often, but the amount is small.

loadout.name: Judgement
loadout.text: Thunder Cleaver:  Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.
loadout.plain: Hit it after Ambush lands you in the middle of the enemy: it hits everyone around you and heals you per hero hit, topping you up while you wait for Invigorate.

Stack (Healing off the damage): 5 effects on one trigger: Rapture, Draconum, Judgement, Exarch, Fervour.

Stack (Kept alive in fights): 5 effects on one trigger: Basilisk, Judgement, Exarch, Illumination, Fervour. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Overlord, Rapture, Exarch, Fervour.

The Eternal was part of it: Exarch (Illumination + Fervour) sits on the same triggers as the items (healing off the damage; kept alive in fights; every basic attack set off), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Khaimera killed built physical armor (Serath, Steel). Anti-heal on Feng Mao, Serath, Steel. We killed Khaimera 9 times.
Copy it? Too few Khaimera offlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

lines: Lead story: Stayed alive, joined every fight, and each takedown sped up the ultimate. In 61% of the team's kills (more than 90% of Howitzer mid players this patch) and died 5 times (fewer than about 43% of them). Lotus turned 14 takedowns into ability haste, so Make It Rain came back every ~63s instead of 105s.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Howitzer touched shortened Make It Rain, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 62.9s late); fight right after Make It Rain is spent.
Make It Rain at rank 3: 105s base, about 62.9s by the end (40% shorter) from 67 ability haste: Tainted Scepter 10, Astral Catalyst 20, Epoch 8, Lotus 29.
14 takedowns (7 kills, 7 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice), Astral Catalyst, Lotus (Eternal).
Astral Catalyst (Ravenous): Hero Kills reduce your Ultimate Cooldown by 25%.• Hero Assists reduce your Ultimate Cooldown by 15%.
Howitzer dealt 35,187 hero damage, 30% of their team's, with +360 magical power from items.

Penetration: Wraith Leggings 11; against Renna (level 18: about 49 magical armor, 38 after penetration; took 16,086 magical damage from heroes, 50% of all hero damage they took) and Serath (level 15: about 55 magical armor, 44 after penetration; took 9,791 magical damage from heroes, 46% of all hero damage they took) that is about 8% and 8% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Astral Catalyst (item): On damaging a Shielded Target: Deal 40% bonus Damage. Does not exceed the size of the Shield.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Dreambinder (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Slows by 30% for 1s. Reduced to 20% for DoT Abilities.
Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
Masterpiece (Eternal minor): Kills grant 4% Bonus Damage and 5% Movement Speed for 12s, stacking up to 5 times.
Prima Donna (Eternal minor): Deal 10% increased damage to Enemy Heroes, but take 6% increased damage from all sources.
Sustain: Astral Catalyst: On damaging a Shielded Target: Deal 40% bonus Damage. Does not exceed the size of the Shield.; 2,507 healing recorded.
Toughness: +525 health; took 27,551 damage, mitigated 14,406, died 5 times.

Loadout augment Sniper Shells: Each basic attack stacks attack speed and omnivamp, up to 5 times. Omnivamp heals you from all damage, abilities included, so keep firing between abilities in lane to trade and heal back. (game text: Howitzer's Basic Attacks grant him 4% Total Attack Speed and 1.5% Omnivamp for 4.5s, stacking up to 5 times.) Field: 43.2% in 1448 games, 28% of picks, below the hero-role's 48.5%.

Loadout Eternal Lotus: Generic: every 2 minutes and every takedown you get a random small boost to damage, cooldowns, speed or health. Nothing specific to Howitzer. (game text: Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.) [29 random bonuses this game (every 2 min plus 14 takedowns), 1 in 4 each: about +7.3% damage, about +29 ability haste, about +5.4% move speed, about +9.1% max health (expected)] Field: 56.1% in 262 games, 5% of picks, above the hero-role's 48.5%.

Loadout minor Masterpiece: Each kill gives stacking bonus damage and movement speed for a short time. Make It Rain can pick up several kills, which stacks it fast. (game text: Kills grant 4% Bonus Damage and 5% Movement Speed for 12s, stacking up to 5 times.) Field: 60% in 30 games, 11% of picks, above the hero-role's 48.5%.

Loadout minor Prima Donna: You deal more damage to heroes but take more from everything. A risky boost for a hero who already has little escape. (game text: Deal 10% increased damage to Enemy Heroes, but take 6% increased damage from all sources.) Field: 58.6% in 87 games, 33% of picks, above the hero-role's 48.5%.

Loadout crest Epoch: Your panic button. When a diver jumps you, freeze yourself to wait out their burst, then Land Mine them away. (game text: Stasis Device:  Enter Stasis for 2.5s.) Field: 49.6% in 2455 games, 48% of picks, above the hero-role's 48.5%.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Wraith Leggings, Dreambinder. Howitzer has 4 damaging abilities (H11 Cluster Grenades, R2000 Missile, Land Mine hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 67 ability haste brought them back 40% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Every takedown fed): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Scepter, Lotus. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Astral Catalyst, Lotus. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

The Eternal was part of it: Lotus (Masterpiece + Prima Donna) sits on the same triggers as the items (every takedown fed; kept alive in fights), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.
Countered? 1 of the 3 players Howitzer killed built magical armor (Steel). We killed Howitzer 5 times.
Copy it? Lotus: 56.1% in 262 Howitzer midlane games, above the hero's 48.5%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

ability.name: Vortex Grenade
ability.what: Launch a grenade in target direction that explodes upon contact with an Enemy Target, dealing 35/60/85/110/135 (+45%) magical damage in a small area and Slowing by 30% for 0.75s.

loadout.plain: An extra Vortex Grenade charge, and Rocket Dash gives one back. More grenades means more ability casts, which keeps Gunslinger's triple shot coming.

loadout.name: Vermis
loadout.text: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
loadout.plain: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero adds damage based on their max health. Casting abilities speeds up TwinBlast's attacks, so it procs often; strongest into tanks.

loadout.name: Serration
loadout.text: Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
loadout.plain: Adds missing-health damage on top of Vermis procs, helping finish hurt targets.

loadout.text: Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.
loadout.plain: Extra damage only into enemies stacked with physical armor. Pick it into armored tanks.

members.text: On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 45 (+35%) Damage On-Hit. Can Critically Strike. Heals you for 50% of damage dealt.

members.name: Vermis
members.text: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.

members.name: Melting Point
members.text: Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.

stacks.text: 3 effects on one trigger: Solaris, Vermis, Melting Point. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

stacks.title: Healing off the damage

members.name: Solaris
members.text: On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 45 (+35%) Damage On-Hit. Can Critically Strike. Heals you for 50% of damage dealt.

members.name: Eviscerator
members.text: Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.

stacks.text: 2 effects on one trigger: Solaris, Eviscerator.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; kept alive in fights), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.

countered.text: 1 of the 4 players TwinBlast killed built physical armor (Khaimera).

copy.text: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point): 47% in 3,421 TwinBlast carry games, below the hero's 50.1%; this 3-item core: 55.5% in 832 games, above the 54.2% of that hero-role's cores. Mixed: copy the part that wins, not the whole setup.

loadout.name: Grenadier
loadout.text: Vortex Grenades has 1 additional Max Charge. Rocket Dash grants 1 charge on use.

ability.name: Vortex Grenade
ability.what: Launch a grenade in target direction that explodes upon contact with an Enemy Target, dealing 35/60/85/110/135 (+45%) magical damage in a small area and Slowing by 30% for 0.75s.

loadout.plain: An extra Vortex Grenade charge, and Rocket Dash gives one back. More grenades means more ability casts, which keeps Gunslinger's triple shot coming.

loadout.name: Vermis
loadout.text: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
loadout.plain: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero adds damage based on their max health. Casting abilities speeds up TwinBlast's attacks, so it procs often; strongest into tanks.

loadout.name: Serration
loadout.text: Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
loadout.plain: Adds missing-health damage on top of Vermis procs, helping finish hurt targets.

loadout.name: Melting Point
loadout.text: Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.
loadout.plain: Extra damage only into enemies stacked with physical armor. Pick it into armored tanks.

loadout.name: Eviscerator
loadout.text: Rending Strikes:  Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.
loadout.plain: A burst of attack speed, healing on all damage, and extra on-hit damage for 6s. Vaporize applies on-hit effects at 200% effectiveness, so it hits hard during this.
